source_instruction: i am looking for anti aging cream with green tea and hyaluronic acid. i want it to be effective for dark circles
query: Ugh, I swear the barista at my usual coffee shop messed up my oat milk latte three times this week—first they added vanilla syrup even though I asked for none, then they made it scalding hot enough to burn my tongue, and yesterday they forgot the lid entirely and spilled half of it on my canvas tote bag right as I was rushing to catch the bus. I’ve been meaning to pick up a new insulated travel mug too, maybe one with a little silicone sleeve so it doesn’t slip out of my hand when I’m juggling my keys and headphones. Oh right, I’m browsing the eye care section right now—since I know you guys don’t carry any eye products with green tea in stock anyway, can you show me anti-aging eye treatments that target dark circles, have hyaluronic acid, and are under $50?
